test_cases.title: Set Thermostat Temperature to 72°F
preconditions: Web server is active and user is logged in.

steps.action: Navigate to the Thermostat Control section in the DH web interface.
steps.expected_result: Thermostat control interface displays successfully.

steps.action: Select a thermostat and enter '72' in the target temperature field.
steps.expected_result: Value '72' is accepted in the input field.

steps.action: Click the Submit button.
steps.expected_result: System saves set point and updates target temperature to 72°F.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

steps.action: Navigate to Thermostat Settings.
steps.expected_result: Thermostat setting panel opens.

steps.action: Enter '60' for target temperature and click Save.
steps.expected_result: Lower boundary setting 60°F is accepted.

steps.action: Enter '80' for target temperature and click Save.
steps.expected_result: Upper boundary setting 80°F is accepted.

steps.action: Enter '59' for target temperature and click Save.
steps.expected_result: System rejects value and displays error message.

source_references.section: 4.2.1.1 A DH user shall be able to read the tempera ture at a thermostat
source_references.excerpt: temperatures to between 60 ° F and 80 ° F, inclusive, at one degree increments.

test_cases.title: Trigger Sound and Light Alarms on Contact Sensor Breach
preconditions: Simulated environment with contact sensor and alarm devices active.

steps.action: Ensure security monitoring is active with contact sensor CLOSED.
steps.expected_result: Security system status indicates armed and secure.

steps.action: Simulate opening the contact sensor to change state to OPEN.
steps.expected_result: Contact sensor state changes to OPEN.

steps.action: Observe the security system alarm response.
steps.expected_result: Alarm system is activated.

test_cases.title: Toggle Power Switch State from OFF to ON and ON to OFF
preconditions: Appliance power switch is registered in system.

steps.action: Navigate to Appliance Manager and locate target power switch in OFF state.
steps.expected_result: Power switch status displays OFF.

steps.action: Click toggle control to change power switch state to ON.
steps.expected_result: Power switch state changes to ON and connected appliance receives power.

steps.action: Click toggle control again to change power switch state to OFF.
steps.expected_result: Power switch state reverts to OFF.
